thread:
maria.design: Heads-up: new ephemeral toast for model "run" finish on dark console. Mock attached. Needs quick a11y pass: SR announcement, focus behavior, contrast, and keyboard hints. CTA: "Open results".

nate.a11y: If it's actionable, prefer moving focus into the toast when triggered by the user. Add an sr-only prefix like 'Notification:' and aria-atomic=true. aria-live alone is unreliable for actions.

leo.frontend: Plan: toast shows after user clicks Run, auto-dismiss 8s, Esc closes. We'll focus the primary button and save/restore the trigger. Toast will be tabindex=-1 so we can focus container if needed.

maria.design: Color check: mock uses text #e8e8e8 on bg #111114 (~4.0:1). Nate, recommend color?

nate.a11y: Use #fafafa for body copy (gets ~4.8:1). CTA label vs CTA bg must also meet contrast; ensure focus ring >=3:1. Keep animations <=200ms and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

anya.pm: Copy tweak: make it contextual, e.g. 'Result ready — Summarizer v2' and CTA 'Open results'. Keep SR hint 'Press Enter to open' as sr-only.

leo.frontend: Implementation snippet and tests planned. Will add unit test for focus restore and e2e keyboard flow. I'll open PR and tag you both.
